prompt: Create a polished cinematic studio portrait composite featuring a young woman shown in exactly two layers of the same person. The foreground layer is a full-body fashion portrait positioned slightly left of center, walking calmly toward the camera with a relaxed confident posture, one hand in her trouser pocket and the other arm resting naturally at her side. She has dark brown hair styled in a loose low updo with soft face-framing strands, light hazel-green eyes, natural makeup, and a serene neutral expression. She wears a pale blush-pink satin button-up blouse with the sleeves casually rolled, high-waisted wide-leg ivory trousers with front pleats, and clean white sneakers. Behind her on the right side, add a much larger semi-transparent close-up portrait of the same woman from chest up, softly blended into the background like a ghosted double exposure; the large face should look forward with the same calm expression and occupy most of the upper-right half of the frame. Use a vertical 3:4 canvas, centered studio composition, muted gray textured backdrop, subtle smoky fog drifting across the lower third and wrapping around the legs, and a dark gray studio floor. Lighting should be soft and cinematic with gentle frontal key light, smooth skin detail, shallow contrast, realistic fabric texture, and a refined editorial look. Keep the color palette gray, ivory, blush pink, and soft skin tones. No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra people, no props, and no background objects.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的电影感影棚合成人像，画面包含 一位年轻女性 的两个完全相同的图层。前景图层为全身时尚人像，位于画面中心偏左位置，神态从容地向镜头走来，姿态放松自信，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手臂自然垂在身侧。她留着 深棕色 头发，梳成松散的低发髻，脸颊两侧留有柔和的发丝，拥有浅榛绿色双眼，妆容自然，表情宁静中性。她身穿淡腮红粉色缎面衬衫，袖口随意卷起，搭配高腰象牙白阔腿褶皱长裤和干净的白色运动鞋。在她右后方，添加一张尺寸更大、半透明的同款女性胸部以上特写人像，如幽灵般的双重曝光效果般柔和地融入背景；大尺寸面部应直视前方，保持同样的冷静表情，占据画面右上半部分的大部分空间。使用 3:4 竖构图，居中影棚布局，背景为哑光灰色纹理，底部三分之一处有淡淡的烟雾缭绕并环绕双腿，地面为深灰色影棚地板。光影应柔和且具有电影质感，采用温和的正面主光，皮肤细节细腻，对比度柔和，织物纹理真实，呈现出高级的杂志大片质感。色调保持灰色、象牙白、腮红粉和柔和肤色。画面中无文字、无 Logo、无水印、无额外人物、无道具，背景中无杂物。
